action.description: High-level action descriptor. Maps to operation.

archive_path.description: Path to the local archive file.

operation.description: The primary operation: create (-c), list (-l), extract (-x), append (-a), or print (-p).

quiet.description: Enable quiet mode, no output except errors (-q).

archive_type.description: Explicitly define archive type: gz, lha, tar, tgz, zip, or zoo (--type).

archive_comment.description: Comment to store in the archive (--archive-comment).

use_iri.description: Use an IRI to access the archive (--iri).

files.description: List of files/directories to operate on. For extraction/listing, this can specify specific members. For creation/appending, these are the sources.
